purpose: Primary-source foundation for the bounded vector-only source-alpha experiment

sources.title: W3C CSS Masking Module Level 1, section 9.1 mask element
sources.claim: userSpaceOnUse expresses mask region and content in user coordinates, permitting explicit native pixel-grid vector geometry

sources.title: W3C CSS Masking Module Level 1, section 9.2 mask-type
sources.claim: mask-type alpha uses the alpha values of mask content; implementation sets this explicitly

status_note: The cited document is a Candidate Recommendation Draft; specifications alone do not establish renderer correctness. Actual resvg 0.49.0 native tests are recorded separately in alpha_comparison.json. Inkscape/Illustrator/Figma interoperability remains unverified.
